graydient_workflow.author: Graydient Pipeline
graydient_workflow.description: Drive a virtual camera around a still image with numeric azimuth / elevation / dolly controls compiled into the prompt. Local equivalent of H3 Max Camera Control.

field_mapping.default_value: Cinematic shot, stable subject, consistent lighting.
field_mapping.help_text: Scene description; the camera move is appended automatically.
Sampling steps. 4 = TaoMate 3-step LoRA + 1; use 8 with strength 0.
TaoMate turbo LoRA strength, applied to model AND clip. 0.0 disables it (then use 8 steps).
Canvas width (multiple of 32). Shared by the H3 node and the reframe pad.
Canvas height (multiple of 32). Shared by the H3 node and the reframe pad.
Frame count at 24 fps, snapped to the 17k+5 grid.

graydient_workflow.name: minimax-h3-camera-control-v1
